task.description:
Produce a design artefact for API-08 (Bearer token auth) at src/design/api-auth.md.

API-08 requires Bearer token authentication for all API endpoints. Design the module interface, types, and integration points:

1. Define an AuthToken type and AuthResult enum (authenticated with role, unauthenticated, forbidden)
2. Define a middleware function that extracts Bearer token from Authorization header, validates it, and either passes through or returns 401/403
3. Bootstrap token design: read BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN env var at startup; in non-production, accept it as PLATFORM_ADMIN; in production, refuse to start if set
4. Token validation: check Authorization header exists, parse 'Bearer <token>' format, validate token, attach role to request context
5. Error handling: missing header → 401 + WWW-Authenticate, malformed header → 401, unknown/revoked token → 401, insufficient permissions → 403
6. Integration: middleware runs BEFORE route handlers; all routes require auth

Per the backend developer guide §6 format: include Module name, Zig source files, Public types, Public functions, Error types, and Integration notes.
acceptance_criteria: Covers all acceptance criteria from API-08 requirement
Defines module interface: types, functions, error handling
Addresses all edge cases: missing header, malformed header, bootstrap token, production safety

result.summary: Design artefact for API-08 Bearer token auth middleware at src/design/api-auth.md. Defines AuthToken, AuthContext, Role enum, AuthResult union types; init/authenticate/deinit public functions; complete error taxonomy mapping 6 auth failure conditions to HTTP 401 + WWW-Authenticate and 1 authorisation failure to HTTP 403; bootstrap token design with BPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN env var and production-safety fatal error; Mermaid data flow diagram; middleware chain integration (after trace, before rbac/content_type/validate/route); two new error constructors needed in src/api/errors.zig (problemUnauthorized, problemForbidden).
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for src/api/middleware/auth.zig implementation and src/api/errors.zig extension
